messages:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only deploy (canary 10%) initiated by @elaine. Target: routing.policy.v2 overrides + batching/timeouts. Rolling to shards: canary-shard-17
elaine: Deploying small-window config changes. Key deltas:
```
batch_window_ms: 25 -> 15
soft_timeout_ms: 1200 -> 900
per_request_token_limit: 2048 -> 1024
routing.policy.weight_low_latency_pool: 0.6 -> 0.75
kv_cache_ttl: unchanged
```
No model binary changes. Pin canary to vicuna-v1.3-q8. Will monitor for 20m then ramp. :eyes:
sasha: Ack. I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and error-rate dashboards. Alert if p95 > 350ms or error_rate > 0.6%.
mike: Quick check — are we pinning quantized build only for canary? I want explicit fallback if cache/kv blowup. Also please post rollback steps.
elaine: yes pinned to vicuna-v1.3-q8 (quant q8) for canary. Fallback chain: vicuna-v1.2 -> vicuna-compat-legacy. Rollback steps in short: 1) flip routing.policy back to v1 baseline 2) restore soft_timeout_ms=1200 3) revert batch_window to 25ms 4) scale canary to 0% 5) notify SRE/Eng #oncall. Link: https://runbook.internal/release-playbooks/config-rollback
jordan: Adding an automated safety: if p95 > 800ms OR error_rate > 1% for 2 consecutive 1m windows, route 5% traffic to dedicated-low-latency pool and pause ramp.
ops-bot: [monitor] Created watch rule: canary_1745206789_watch. Triggers: p95>800ms, err_rate>1% OR p50 spike > 2x baseline. Will post alerts to #incidents and page oncall.
sasha: saw canary shard warmup logs: all healthy so far. p50 ~ 90ms, p95 ~ 220ms. No increased 5xx. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary at 10% -> metering: 12 successful shards, 0 errors, average latency 110ms. Proceed to 30%?
mike: hold on ramp to 30% until we confirm no mem pressure on canary nodes. I saw small KV eviction on shard-17 earlier.
elaine: good catch. paused ramp. scaling up canary node mem by +2GiB for shard-17, retest. If still evicting, rollback.
ops-bot: shard-17 mem bump scheduled (infra-autoscaler). Will report back in 2m.
sasha: rerun warmup requests against shard-17, looks stable now. p95 240ms. eviction counters zero. Recommend continue to 30%.
mike: +1 to continue, but keep timeout bumpable from 900->1200 via quick flag.
elaine: Ramp to 30% started. Observability team: keep /dashboards/infra/canary-1745206789 open.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 30% completed. Metrics snapshot: p50 95ms, p95 260ms, error_rate 0.08%. No alarms.
sasha: continuing to watch for next 20m. If p95 crosses 350ms for >3m, we revert routing weights and set soft_timeout=1200.
mike: If we need to rollback, prefer targeted config revert rather than full deploy (flip routing + timeout). I'll prepare PR to revert quickly.
jordan: noted — added temporary gating: do not exceed 3x baseline token concurrency on canary.
elaine: post-deploy note: release notes draft: "Config-only: lower batch window and timeout for lower tail latency; increased weight to low-latency pool; pinned canary to vicuna-v1.3-q8. No model binary changes. Monitoring & rollback gating applied." Will publish after 2h quiet window.
ops-bot: canary is healthy. No paging thresholds crossed. Closing ephemeral watch after 30m if stable.
mike: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. If anything odd, ping @mike directly.
elaine: Thanks team — keeping this as a slow ramp for next 2 hours, will update thread with any rollback or completion. :shipit:
